label: #3155130: "Edit summary" toggle on long text with summary, 2020 patch ported to core f48d0a58 (pinned)
description: Compare the Edit summary / Hide summary toggle (Before) with the 2020 patch wrapping the summary field in a details element (After). The patch is a port of core-summary-a11y-3155130-6.patch to the last core commit that still has the widget. Not an MR: lab-written port.
status: draft: ported 2020 patch, nothing run yet

steps.text: Open Add Basic page on both sides. The recipe adds Body (one value) and Notes (three values), both Text (formatted, long, with summary).
steps.lookFor: A Body field and three Notes fields, each with a way to reach a Summary field.

steps.text: Look at the Body field. Before: an Edit summary / Hide summary button beside the label. After: a Summary details disclosure.
steps.lookFor: Before: button inside a label, Summary textarea appears above the control that reveals it. After: details element, summary inside it.

steps.text: Tab to the control, activate it with Enter or Space, and listen for or inspect the accessible name of the Body and Summary textareas before and after.
steps.lookFor: Before: Body name changes between "Body (Edit summary)" and "Body". After: name stays "Body"; the disclosure reports expanded or collapsed.

steps.text: Repeat for the three Notes fields. Tab through them with the keyboard.
steps.lookFor: Every control is visible when focused; each summary is distinguishable by name.

steps.text: Type text in Body and in its Summary, fill Title, Save, then open Edit.
steps.lookFor: The summary you typed is still there. The 2020 patch changes the summary field name attribute; this step shows whether it still saves.

expected: After: the summary is reached by a details disclosure, not a button inside a label; names stay stable; the summary still saves.
actual: Before: the toggle is a button inside the label, it is replaced by another button when used, the summary appears before its control, and the textarea name changes when toggled.

checks.label: Page has the Body and Notes summary fields
Summary textareas sit inside a details element
Summary field keeps its name field_body[0][summary]

observe.question: Is the Summary reached through a disclosure that stays in the same place and keeps the field name the same?
After Save and Edit, is the summary text you typed still there?
